decisions.decision: Record the app definition and source on each deployment row (migration 0006)
decisions.why: digests are already per deployment; only the definition is missing
decisions.rejected: Nomad job revert; a separate definitions table

decisions.decision: Redeploy runs saveAndDeploy with pinned digests and a source
decisions.why: one deploy path, every deploy rule applies

decisions.decision: Registry HEAD of each digest before anything changes
decisions.why: Resolve returns digest refs without asking the registry
decisions.rejected: letting Nomad fail the pull later

decisions.decision: Warn on removed secrets for every deploy, and show them in the console confirmation
decisions.why: any deploy that drops a secret deletes its value

decisions.decision: Hand-written HCL writer in nomadjob with golden files and a field-coverage test
decisions.rejected: hclwrite + go-cty; rendering Nomad stored job

decisions.decision: Export = Translate(definition, deployment, current settings) + header
decisions.why: pure, no Nomad access, no policy change

decisions.decision: Gate step parses the export with Nomad and plans it: diff None

plan.summary: Definition per deployment, redeploy through saveAndDeploy with pinned digests, export via a pure HCL writer
plan.key_finding: Deployments store only digests today, and registry.Resolve never checks a digest exists

approach: Every deployment records its definition. Redeploying a healthy past deployment saves that definition and runs the normal deploy with its digests pinned, after a registry existence check. Export renders Translate's job as HCL with a hand-written pure writer and a header listing cluster prerequisites.
